definitions.gloss: desperate, reckless, throwing caution to the wind
definitions.explanation: An attitude of not caring about consequences anymore, often because one has given up hope. Acting recklessly out of desperation or resignation.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}な{態度|たいど}を{取|と}る。
examples.english: To take a reckless, defiant attitude.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}になって{全部|ぜんぶ}やめてしまった。
どんなに{辛|つら}くても、{捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}にならないでほしい。
examples.english: No matter how hard it is, I don't want you to give up and act recklessly.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}になる: to become desperate/reckless
- {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}な{態度|たいど}: a defiant, don't-care attitude
- {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}な{気持|きも}ち: a feeling of desperation

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "thrown-away bowl" — from a Buddhist begging bowl ({鉢|はち}). Throwing away the bowl symbolizes abandoning all discipline and restraint.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やけくそ: reckless abandon (more colloquial)
- {自暴自棄|じぼうじき}: desperation, giving up on oneself (more formal)
